name: Oracle discovery indexer
description: Builds a local, fully rebuildable keyword index of every Oracle listing on Arweave (signature-checked) and searches it by text, kind and capability. Disposable by design: anyone can rebuild an identical index from the chain, so no single index operator is authoritative.

spec.install: git clone https://github.com/Technosophorso/oracle.git && cd oracle && npm install
commands: npm run discovery -- build [--gateway url] [--out file] [--rebuild]
npm run discovery -- search <query> [--kind tool|agent] [--capability x] [--index file] [--limit n]
